pool.scene: A chamber-musician retensions a loose harpsichord string in an empty rehearsal room; a folded black velvet cover holds fallen ivory blossoms, and a narrow gap in an antique gilt folding screen catches late daylight.
pool.carrying_relation: The released string and her fingertips suspended above it make the end of a sounding test visible.

pool.scene: A stained-glass conservator tests a repaired hinged flower panel in a quiet exhibition workshop; the panel opens by a hand-width, warm light passes through a seam, and the shadow of its white blossoms crosses her black lace sleeve.
pool.carrying_relation: One hand stabilizes the panel while the other holds a small brush above fresh gold-leaf repairs; the opening reveals the visible result of the work.

pool.scene: A theater costume artisan sits at a dark fitting table between an antique gilt stage screen and a half-finished floral collar; she releases a needle after joining two ivory flower appliques while a relaxed black ribbon rests on the tabletop.
pool.carrying_relation: The secured appliques and the next loose flower reveal a task paused between completion and continuation.

pool.scene: An installation florist stands in an empty small gallery, balancing an ivory flowering branch in a gilded narrow support; the shifted branch opens a thin warm-light corridor behind a dark embroidered dress.
pool.carrying_relation: Her palm steadies the newly aligned branch while its soft shadow shifts onto the exhibition wall.

pool.scene: A quiet stage technician rehearses a hand-cranked antique scenic shutter beside a small organ; its parted gilt leaves create a vertical gold slit through hanging pale blossoms while she keeps a black velvet cord gently tensioned.
pool.carrying_relation: The cord, pulley and partly open shutter form a legible causal chain in the pause after her adjustment.

pool.scene: A marionette artisan lowers a carved floral theater puppet onto a dark velvet workbench in a silent studio; ivory blossoms frame a gilt folding screen while the slackening control strings catch a fine rim of daylight.
pool.carrying_relation: The settled puppet and relaxed strings mark the visible change from animation to stillness.
